summary.zh: 字节跳动的 AI 模型，具备强大的短视频和内容理解能力。

title.en: ByteDance Doubao API Key - Short Video AI Models | Get Model Key
title.zh: 字节跳动豆包 API Key - 短视频 AI 模型 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get ByteDance Doubao API key for AI models. Access Doubao series with strong short video understanding.
description.zh: 获取字节跳动豆包 API Key，访问 AI 模型。使用豆包系列，具备强大的短视频理解能力。

en: ByteDance’s Doubao models are offered for developers via Volcengine Ark, spanning Pro/Lite text models plus vision and audio variants.
Pick Doubao on Ark when you need Chinese multimodal APIs with ByteDance/Volcengine cloud tooling for content and short-video style understanding.
Ark is Volcengine’s official model platform (cloud product), not a reseller directory. Get Model Key only links to Volcengine; we do not sell keys.
zh: 字节跳动豆包模型通过火山引擎方舟（Ark）向开发者开放，涵盖专业版/轻量版文本以及视觉、音频等能力。
若需要中文多模态 API，并希望结合火山引擎云产品做内容与短视频理解类能力，可选择方舟上的豆包。
方舟是火山引擎官方模型平台（云产品），不是转售目录。Get Model Key 仅跳转火山引擎，不售卖 API Key。

en: Open Volcengine and go to the Ark product page (volcengine.com/product/ark).
Create or select an Ark inference endpoint / Doubao model resource in the Ark console.
Generate an API key in Ark’s key management for that project.
Call Ark’s OpenAPI with the key and model endpoint IDs from Volcengine docs (docs path 82379).
zh: 打开火山引擎并进入方舟产品页（volcengine.com/product/ark）。
在方舟控制台创建或选择豆包推理接入点/模型资源。
在方舟的密钥管理中为该项目生成 API Key。
使用该 Key 与文档中的模型/接入点 ID 调用方舟 OpenAPI（文档路径 82379）。

question.en: Is Doubao API obtained on doubao.com or Volcengine?
question.zh: 豆包 API 是在豆包网站还是火山引擎申请？

answer.en: Developer API keys for Doubao are managed on Volcengine Ark. Consumer Doubao apps differ from the Ark developer console.
answer.zh: 面向开发者的豆包 API Key 在火山引擎方舟管理；消费级豆包 App 与方舟开发者控制台不是同一入口。

question.en: What Doubao variants are listed here?
question.zh: 这里列出了哪些豆包型号？

answer.en: This directory references Doubao Pro, Lite, Vision, and Audio lines; confirm exact SKUs in the Ark console.
answer.zh: 本目录收录豆包专业版、轻量版、视觉版与音频版等；具体 SKU 以方舟控制台为准。

question.en: Does Get Model Key sell Volcengine Ark keys?
question.zh: Get Model Key 会售卖方舟 Key 吗？

answer.en: No. We only link to official Volcengine Ark pages. Billing is handled by Volcengine.
answer.zh: 不会。本站只链接火山引擎方舟官方页面，计费由火山引擎处理。
